theme: Light theme by default, optimized for outdoor driver visibility and admin office use. Dark mode is optional.

typography.headings: Bold (700) or ExtraBold (800). CRITICAL: Use `tracking-normal`. Never use letter-spacing (`tracking-tight` or `tracking-wide`) in Arabic as it disconnects cursive letters.
typography.body: Regular (400) or Medium (500). Base size must be slightly larger for Arabic readability. Use 16px to 18px for body text.
typography.line_height: CRITICAL: Use `leading-relaxed` (1.625) or `leading-loose` (2). Arabic diacritics get cut off with tight line heights.
typography.font_family_override: Instruct Tailwind to use Tajawal as the default sans font in tailwind.config.js.

primary.description: Trustworthy Deep Azure Blue for primary actions, branding, and active states.

rtl_arabic_guidelines.logical_properties: CRITICAL: Use Tailwind's logical properties. Replace `ml/mr` with `ms/me` (margin-start, margin-end), `pl/pr` with `ps/pe`, `text-left/text-right` with `text-start/text-end`.
rtl_arabic_guidelines.icons: Use `lucide-react`. Ensure directional icons (arrows, chevrons, play/forward) are logically flipped for RTL contexts.
rtl_arabic_guidelines.alignment: Right-align by default for text (which is start-aligned in RTL). Ensure numeric data aligns correctly.

layouts.admin_dashboard: Persistent sidebar navigation on the right (RTL start). Top header with user profile, stats, and quick actions. Content area uses Bento grid principles for KPI stats.
layouts.student_portal: Clean, mobile-first centered layout with a bottom navigation bar on mobile, or top navigation on desktop. Large CTA for 'New Booking'.
layouts.driver_screen: Ultra-simplified mobile-first view. Large tap targets (minimum h-12/48px). High contrast. One prominent card per trip with an ordered list of students and a massive 'Navigate via Maps' button.
layouts.dispatch_seat_map: Visual Van layout inside a Card. Grid of 8 seats representing a minivan. Row 1: 2 seats (passenger + gap + driver implied). Row 2: 3 seats. Row 3: 3 seats. Use color-coding to show Male/Female/Empty. Enforce gender lock visually.

components.buttons: Rounded-lg or pill-shaped. High contrast. Add interactive hover states (`hover:bg-blue-800`). Use `h-11` or `h-12` for primary actions.
components.cards: Cardless or subtle border (`border-slate-200`) with soft shadow (`shadow-sm`). Solid white background. NO transparent backgrounds.
components.forms: Use customized Shadcn UI forms. Inputs must have clear labels on the right (RTL). Select components must not have transparent backgrounds.
components.tables: Dense rows for admin. Striped rows (`even:bg-slate-50`) for readability. Status columns use colored Badges.
components.map_picker: Aspect-video container using Leaflet/React-Leaflet to drop a pin. Small embedded map purely for coordinate extraction.

vehicles.description: White passenger van driving, use as placeholder for vehicle details/cards.

students.description: University students walking, use for student portal login/registration background.

drivers.description: Friendly male driver in van, use for driver profile avatar.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js/.jsx) for React components, DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them. Strip standard generic borders if possible, use Tailwind to match the defined theme.
Implement React Hook Form for Bookings and Registration.
For the Dispatch UI, construct the Van visual map using CSS Grid. Add visual validation so a user understands if a seat assignment violates the row's gender lock.

The Map Component only needs to capture Lat/Lng (to save a point). When displaying to the driver, construct a button that opens `href='https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=${lat},${lng}'`.
Make sure to apply the 'dir=rtl' attribute at the top level and ensure all text aligns appropriately to the right.
universal_guidelines: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='login-submit-button'`).
Do not use generic centered layouts. Asymmetry creates interest. Left-align (or Right-align in RTL) forms, dense content, and data.
Never apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Target specific properties like `transition-colors` or `transition-transform`.
Add micro-animations on buttons and cards using hover and active states.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on structural surfaces like headers or dropdown menus.
